title: Implicit conversion operators
summary: Conversion contexts do not navigate to the invoked conversion operator yet
prose:
Go-to-definition from a context that runs a user-defined conversion, a
condition or `!`, does not reach the conversion operator.

value.wrong: should reach Guard::operator bool, which the condition calls (clangd#1931)
should reach Guard::operator bool, which ! calls (clangd#1931)
